AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to increasing

items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S8988

SPONSOR: AVELLA
 
TITLE OF BILL:  An act to amend the environmental conservation law, in
relation to increasing certain penalties relating to endangered and
special species, species of special concern and illegal ivory articles
and rhinoceros horns

 
PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:

The purpose of this bill is to increase the penalties for violations
involving endangered and threatened species.

 
SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:

This bill would:

*increase the endangered or threatened species civil penalty,

*require the Department of Environmental Conservation to:

-increase public awareness regarding the importance of protecting endan-
gered and threatened species,

-publicize laws protecting such species.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Not only do endangered and threatened species add beauty and wonder to
the natural world, but they provide diversity necessary for the mainte-
nance for our ecosystems. This bill would help increase awareness of the
need for protections of such species and provide additional deterrents
to their harm by increasing civil penalties.

 
PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

None

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL GOVERNMENTS:

None to the State.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.
